source_unit: immutable document version with per-segment language and physical/printed page locators
parallel_english: reuse only verified aligned equivalents; retain conflicting passages
versioning: One immutable translation version per source/method configuration. Reports pin the translation version used; newer translations do not mutate historical citations.
coverage: Every source segment accounted for, including tables, footnotes and headings. A failed/unreadable segment prevents a complete translation claim.
quality_reporting: Advisory notes preserve scope and source qualifications in saved readings. Unresolved translation fidelity or required-coverage defects remain blocking quality flags; they are never silently cleared.
reading: Read and download saved copies without a model call.
independent_job: Translate one or many registered documents without running evidence extraction or changing Country Profiles.
current_status: Local worker executes full-segment translation with explicit per-segment source language, frozen original bytes, aligned English, terminology decisions and execution receipts. Country and independent translation versions are saved in SQLite and read/downloaded without inference. Conditional page review/OCR preparation is local and requires visual approval. Official-parallel matching, semantic quality certification and hosted storage remain deferred. The standalone artifact writer produces the listed file set; the local reader offers JSON, CSV, readable HTML and English text exports.
